results.name: V Crunches
instructions: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your arms extended on the floor overhead.
Simultaneously lift your legs and torso off the floor, reaching your hands towards your feet to form a 'V' shape with your body.
Squeeze your abdominal muscles at the top of the movement, ensuring your hands reach towards your feet.
Slowly lower your legs and torso back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift into the 'V' position and inhale as you lower back down.
Avoid using momentum to lift your legs and torso; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Keep your legs and arms straight throughout the movement for maximum effectiveness.
results.description: V Crunches is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Walkout
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms relaxed by your sides.
Bend your hips and knees to place your hands on the floor before you.
Walk your hands forward, keeping your legs straight, until you are in a plank position with your hands under your shoulders and your body forming a straight line from head to heels.
Walk your hands back towards your feet, lifting your hips and forming an inverted V shape with your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Avoid letting your hips sag or rise too high when in the plank position.
Keep your legs as straight as possible while walking your hands to and from the plank position.
Use a mat to provide cushioning for your hands and prevent slipping.
results.description: Walkout is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Hamstrings, Glutes.

results.name: Wheels to Heaven
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight together, and your arms resting by your sides. Position an ab roller between your heels.
Lift your legs up towards the ceiling, keeping them slightly bent, holding the ab roller securely between your heels.
Engage your core and push your legs upward, raising your hips high off the floor.
Lower your hips back down slowly keeping your legs up. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Start with a smaller range of motion if you are new to the exercise and gradually increase it as you gain strength.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you lift your legs and hips, and inhale as you lower them back down.
Avoid using momentum to lift your hips; focus on using your abdominal muscles.
results.description: Wheels to Heaven is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

results.name: Wheels to Toes
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight together and your arms extended diagonally overhead, holding an ab roller.
Lift your legs up towards the ceiling, keeping them straight, and simultaneously raise the ab roller towards your toes, lifting your upper back off the floor.
Slowly lower your legs and the ab roller back down to the starting position, stopping just before they touch the floor.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a mat or soft surface to support your back and prevent discomfort.
Ensure your lower back stays in contact with the floor when your legs are lowered.
Start with a smaller range of motion if you are new to the exercise and gradually increase it as you gain strength.
results.description: Wheels to Toes is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with a wheel roller, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Shoulders.

results.name: Wind Wipers
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended out to the sides for stability, lift your legs up towards the ceiling, and keep them bent at 90 degrees.
Lower your knees to the right side, keeping them bent together until they are just above the floor.
Raise your knees back to the center position, and then lower them to the left side until they are just above the floor.
Repeat the movement, alternating sides, for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Use a mat or soft surface to support your back and prevent discomfort.
Avoid using momentum to move your legs; focus on using your abdominal and oblique muscles.
Keep your shoulders flat on the floor to maintain stability and proper form.
results.description: Wind Wipers is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

results.name: 45 Degree Hyperextension (Arms in Front of Chest)
instructions: Fix your feet to the footrests and press your thighs against the padded platform.
Place your arms across your chest and lean forward.
Raise yourself by leaning backward and forming an upright position.
Hold for a while, return to the initial position, and repeat.
tips: Keep your movements slow and controlled to maintain proper form and maximize muscle engagement.
Avoid hyperextending your back; stop when your body forms a straight line to prevent strain on your lower back.
Engage your core muscles throughout the exercise to support your spine and maintain stability.
results.description: 45 Degree Hyperextension (Arms in Front of Chest) is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings.

results.name: Alternating Superman
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended straight in front of you and your legs extended straight behind you.
Lift your right arm and left leg simultaneously off the floor, engaging your core and back muscles. Hold briefly.
Lower your right arm and left leg back to the mat.
Lift your left arm and right leg simultaneously off the floor, holding briefly before lowering them back to the mat. Continue alternating sides.
tips: Engage your core throughout the exercise to maintain stability and protect your lower back.
Focus on lifting your arm and leg to the same height to maintain balance and symmetry.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
results.description: Alternating Superman is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hamstrings.

results.name: Around the World Superman Hold
instructions: Lie face down on a mat with your arms extended straight to your sides and your legs extended straight behind you.
Lift your arms, chest, and legs off the floor, holding the Superman position.
Move your arms in a circular motion, starting from the initial position, sweeping them around straight forward, and back to the starting position.
Continue moving your arms in a controlled, rhythmic manner while maintaining the Superman hold.
tips: Engage your core and glutes to maintain stability and support your lower back throughout the exercise.
Perform the arm movement slowly and with control to maximize muscle activation and prevent injury.
Focus on keeping your legs and chest lifted off the floor to maintain the Superman hold.
results.description: Around the World Superman Hold is an intermediate multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Hamstrings.

results.name: Assisted Chin Up Normal Width Reverse Grip
instructions: Kneel on the platform pad of an assisted chin-up machine and grasp the handles with a reverse grip (palms facing you) at shoulder-width apart.
Begin the movement by pulling your body upward until your chin is above the bar.
Slowly lower your body back to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, maintaining proper form throughout the exercise.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your body and avoid flaring them out.
Use an appropriate level of assistance on the machine to ensure you can perform the exercise correctly.
Exhale as you pull your body upward and inhale as you lower it back down.
results.description: Assisted Chin Up Normal Width Reverse Grip is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with an assisted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Forearms.

results.name: Assisted Chin Up Reverse Close Grip
instructions: Set the assisted pull-up machine to the support you need and kneel or stand on the platform.
Take a narrow underhand grip on the handles.
Pull yourself up by driving your elbows down until your chin passes the handles.
Lower yourself slowly to full arm extension and repeat.
tips: Avoid swinging; move under control.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
results.description: Assisted Chin Up Reverse Close Grip is a beginner multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the lats (back). Performed with an assisted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Forearms.
